judged_text: createAllCalendarEvents awaits each destination's createEvent sequentially in a for-loop on the booking-creation hot path while the sibling no-credentialId branch (line 377) fans out with Promise.all. Collective bookings pay one full external calendar API round-trip per host in series (hundreds of milliseconds to seconds each), so booking confirmation latency grows linearly with host count and multi-host team bookings become visibly slow.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `createAllCalendarEvents` in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` to iterate destinations with `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar) { ... const createdEvent = await createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId); ... }`, which awaits each `createEvent` sequentially. In the sibling branch (when `credentialId` is not present) it still uses `await Promise.all(...)` to fan out concurrently. This is a diff-grounded performance/latency concern (linear slowdown with number of destinations/hosts), not a functional correctness defect.
